main_text.p: συμβεβηκὸς, non enim hominem sanat medicus, nisi per accidés. ἀλλὰ vacat.
main_text.head: PETRI RAMI PROFESSORIS REGII GRAMMATICÆ GRÆCÆ Liber quartus, de Rectione.

head.i: Cap. 1. De rectione genitivi á substantivo.

main_text.p: VARIA nomina genitivo regunt substantivum, comparativum, superlativum, partitivum, & adjectivum multiplex.
Regens substantivum aliquando reticetur, ut Νηλεὺς ὁ Κόδρῳ [?], Neleus Codri: supple υἱὸς, filius. Lucianus,

page.notes: The Greek in the first line (συμβεβηκὸς, ἀλλὰ) and in Νηλεὺς ὁ Κόδρῳ is hard to read on the scan; accents and final letters are uncertain. The opening initial is a decorative V with the A joined to it, read as VARIA. The mark ζ at the lower right, under the last line, is set apart from the text; it is recorded as a catchword, though it may be a signature or section sign. The heading "Cap. 1." is in italic and "Liber quartus" in the title block is not numbered as a caput.
